subject: *: fix parallel apply wrong result (#51414)
summary: Diff is small and targeted: adds a regression test for parallel apply correctness and fixes PhysicalIndexLookUpReader.Clone to deep-copy CommonHandleCols. Parallel apply builds per-worker inner executors via plannercore.SafeClone(innerPlan); previously the cloned IndexLookUpReader could lose CommonHandleCols, causing the executor builder to treat a common-handle table as int-handle (handleLen=1 / empty handleCols), leading to wrong results. The new clone logic matches executor expectations and remains present in upstream/master (refactored location), with no later corrective follow-up needed.
